Quick Break from Vietnamese Cuisine
Jul 2026 • Couples
Hidden in a small alley near the famous Bun Cha Dac Kim in Hanoi’s Old Quarter, Hanoi Cafe was a wonderful find. They are well known for their breakfast and brunch menu, making it a great spot if you are looking for a break from Vietnamese cuisine.

We arrived at around 10:00 AM, and although there was no wait, the café was almost full, which says a lot about its popularity. We ordered the Big Breakfast and the Avocado Toast, and both were fresh, flavorful, and genuinely delicious. The portions were generous, and the prices are reasonable for the quality and serving size.

The service was warm and friendly. There was a small mix up because of the language barrier, and they brought us two Avocado Toasts instead of the one we ordered. It was not a big deal though, and they quickly took the extra one back.

Set inside a charming old building, the café has a nostalgic atmosphere that adds to the overall experience. Definitely worth a visit while exploring the Old Quarter.
